mechanisms: DH_meth_new / DH_meth_free / DH_meth_dup
DH_meth_set1_name and the other DH_meth_get/set_* accessors
RawMethod partial-construction owner (block-only Drop)
OwnedMethod name-then-table Drop (OB-2 OwnedStr, CRYPTO_* seam)
file_dispositions.note: crypto/dh/dh_meth.c:20-171, all twenty-one exports. zalloc/malloc/strdup coordinates and FILE_DH_METH preserved; DH_meth_new stores flags before the name so its error path can release the block alone; DH_meth_dup copies the 72-byte table before the one deep field and does not release the copied name alias on failure; set1_name duplicates before releasing the old name. Contract text now states that DH_meth_free/DH_meth_set1_name require a table this file created (not DH_OpenSSL's static table). No source behaviour change.

mechanisms: DHparams_print_fp FILE* wrapper (BIO_s_file, BIO_ctrl SET_FILE_PTR/BIO_NOCLOSE, DHparams_print, BIO_free)
ERR_raise at dh_prn.c:28 reconstructed from static FILE/FUNC strings
file_dispositions.note: crypto/dh/dh_prn.c:22-35. BIO owns no caller FILE because the close flag is BIO_NOCLOSE; the single allocation is released on both arms; the raise uses the authority's __FILE__/__LINE__/__func__ values. No ownership transfer, no change.

DH_get_1024_160 / DH_get_2048_224 / DH_get_2048_256 exports
owned-vs-shared group constants asymmetry and NID cache behaviour
file_dispositions.note: crypto/dh/dh_rfc5114.c:28-49. Assignment order p,g,q and direct field stores (no set0_pqg, no dirty_cnt bump) are the authority's and are pinned by tests. mechanisms: BLAKE2b/BLAKE2s parameter byte images and settled param setters
init / init_key / update / final_ entry points
compress block loop and load32/load64/store32/store64
kitchen-sink providers' set_ctx_params digest/key bounds (callers)
file_dispositions.note: providers/implementations/digests/blake2b_prov.c and blake2s_prov.c. init_key derived its copy length from the public (*p).b[1] with only debug_assert!, so a release build could copy past the stack block (b: keylen > 128; s: > 64) and read past key; keylen 0 also fed a zero block. Repaired with `if keylen == 0 || keylen > KEYBYTES { return 0; }` before the context, copy or cleanse (guard is observed by the new test; provider setkey/set_ctx_params already enforce 1..=KEYBYTES, so valid-caller results are unchanged). compress now documents the whole-block read at each block start; init/final_ document the 1..=OUTBYTES digest-length invariant established by the provider.

mechanisms: Md4Ctx repr(C) layout and offset asserts
md4_block_data_order over the shared md32 collector
Md32 impl (nl_nh/num/data_ptr/block/make_string)

file_dispositions.note: crypto/md4/md4_dgst.c and md4_one.c. The RFC's own F/G/H spellings and the three constant bands match the generated table; the collector's block contract (num * MD32_CBLOCK readable) is the only pointer obligation. One-shot cleanses its local context after Final; the static-NULL answer matches the authority.

file_dispositions.note: crypto/md5/md5_dgst.c and md5_one.c. Zeroing in MD5_Init is load-bearing (the first update reads num); the generated word/rotation/constant tables are read rather than recalled; no length-field placement is assumed beyond the asserted layout. No change.

file_dispositions.note: crypto/md5/md5_sha1.c:20-108. MD5 pads are 48 bytes and SHA-1 pads 40, matching the authority; the ctrl arm refuses a mismatched cmd, NULL context and mslen != 48 without touching state, and the intermediates are cleansed before the second phase. No export. No change.

file_dispositions.note: crypto/mdc2/mdc2dgst.c:24-132 and mdc2_one.c. num is only advanced to 7 until Update flushes a full block, so Final's data[i] padding and skip(i) stay in range; that invariant is now stated on Update/Final because num is a public C header field (the authority shares the exposure). Both pad arms reproduce the published recipe vectors. No source change.

safety_contract_repairs: blake2b/blake2s compress: blocks readable for len bytes AND a whole BLOCKBYTES at every block start (staging buffer is BLOCKBYTES wide)
blake2b/blake2s init/final_: digest length 1..=OUTBYTES established by the provider's set_ctx_params
blake2b/blake2s init_key: key length 1..=KEYBYTES, key non-NULL and readable for it; enforced at runtime
rfc5114 make_dh: each *_of returns a live BigNum valid for the call
dh DH_meth_free / DH_meth_set1_name: table allocated by this file's seam, name a CRYPTO_strdup block (never a built-in static table)
mdc2 MDC2_Update / MDC2_Final: num < MDC2_BLOCK, maintained by Init/Update; externally written num is C-invalid
